<video>
The video contains 64 ordered temporal slots sampled at 4 Hz for one 16-second local view.
The emit core is 12 seconds with a 2-second guard on each side.
Segment meaningful local operations. Acquisition and delivery are distinct when observable; retain distinct directional handovers. Ordinary contacts, adjustments and low-motion pauses within the same ongoing goal do not create new events. Keep clear failure/retry or execution-quality transitions as separate intervals even when their intended operation is unchanged. Represent genuine pure rest as an interval, not a gap.
Edge padding repeats the nearest real sampled frame; ignore slots outside the valid tick envelope.
Times use 20 Hz local ticks in the half-open range [0,320).
Canonical window envelope:
{"core_end_tick":280,"core_start_tick":40,"valid_end_tick":320,"valid_start_tick":0}
Emit only intervals with positive half-open intersection with [core_start_tick,core_end_tick). Clip intervals at valid video limits; lo/ro indicate continuation beyond the visible limit. lo=true requires s==valid_start_tick; ro=true requires e==valid_end_tick.
Return exactly one JSON object and no prose or Markdown, with only top-level key segments. Each row has keys exactly in order s,e,lo,ro. Sort rows by (s,e,lo,ro).
